title: Autosaves, named saves, recent games, import/export and deletion
steps: Inspect save-library and save-other, their autosaves and named saves; select, load, overwrite and delete entries.
Return Home and reopen a recent game.
Import uses imports/valid.json by default; use chooseImport() for corrupt/version/duplicate-ID fixtures or cancellation.
Export a game, then inspect its JSON using readFile('exports/<name>.json').
Make moves and inspect auto.json for move-count autosave; reset and repeat a close/save flow against the existing autosave.
